newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-GATTING RESIGNS AS MIDDLESEX CAPTAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GATTING RESIGNS AS MIDDLESEX CAPTAIN.

text.p: Mike Gatting resigned as Middlesex captain on Tuesday after 14 years in charge of the county club.
Gatting, 39, currently an England selector, played 79 tests for his country. He led the last England side to win the Ashes when he captained the 1986-87 team in Australia.
Mark Ramprakash will take over as Middlesex skipper in Thursday's county championship match against Northamptonshire at Lord's.
